anthony-richardson.subject: Anthony Richardson
anthony-richardson.edited_text: Anthony Richardson led the Colts' second-team offense on a field-goal drive during the final day of training camp. The report does not establish whether this was a planned rotation, part of the quarterback competition or a depth-chart change, so it does not support moving his fantasy outlook in either direction.

chris-blair.subject: Chris Blair
chris-blair.edited_text: Chris Blair took most of Jahan Dotson's first-team red-zone snaps during one joint practice. The report does not say why those snaps were available or for how long, and it does not establish that Blair has moved ahead of Dotson.
chris-blair.note: Approved only with explicit context that these were Dotson's snaps on one day. Must not imply Blair permanently passed Dotson.
